text: 2026年11月9日，中国人民银行副行长、国家外汇管理局局长朱鹤新会见来访的橡树资本联席创始人兼联席董事长霍华德•马克斯（Howard Marks）。双方就全球经济形势、中国经济发展机遇等议题进行了交流。国家外汇管理局副局长李红燕陪同会见。（国家外汇管理局微信公号）
text_en: On November 9, 2026, Zhu Hexin, Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China and Administrator of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, met with visiting Howard Marks, Co-Founder and Co-Chairman of Oaktree Capital. The two sides exchanged views on topics including the global economic situation and China's economic development opportunities. SAFE Deputy Administrator Li Hongyan attended the meeting. (SAFE WeChat official account)
